description: This file defines a HashTable class that provides a data structure for storing, managing, and manipulating items implementing the IComparable interface. It includes methods for adding, removing, clearing, and retrieving items by hash code or index, as well as converting the table to an array and cloning it.

classes.name: HashTable
classes.description: A generic hash table implementation for storing objects implementing IComparable, allowing addition, removal, access by hash code or index, and cloning.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that optionally initializes the HashTable with a source array of items.

methods.name: addFromSource
methods.description: Adds multiple items to the hash table from a source array.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a single IComparable item to the hash table based on its hash code.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the specified IComparable item from the hash table.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes all items from the hash table.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the hash table.

methods.name: getIndexForHashCode
methods.description: Returns the index of the item with the specified hash code.

methods.name: getByIndex
methods.description: Retrieves an item by its index in the hash table.

methods.name: getByHashCode
methods.description: Retrieves an item by its hash code.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns all items in the hash table as an array.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Creates a deep clone of the hash table instance.
